name: BRLA Digital
oneLiner: BRLA is Avenia's centralized Brazilian real stablecoin, mint/redeemed 1:1 for BRL and backed by BRL cash equivalents and overnight repurchase agreements.
collateral: BRL cash and cash equivalents plus overnight repurchase agreements collateralized by Brazilian corporate debentures; the June 30, 2026 reserve and circulation totals received reasonable assurance from UHY Bendoraytes
pegMechanism: Fiat-backed 1:1 peg to the Brazilian Real; mint/redeem 1:1 for BRL through Avenia (formerly BRLA Digital) platform after KYC; native multichain deployment without wrapping or bridge dependencies

mintAuthority.summary: BRLA is issued by Avenia (formerly BRLA Digital); mint() on every tracked chain is gated solely by OPERATOR_ROLE (0x97667070c54ef182b0f5858b034beac1b6f3089aa2d3188bb1e8929f4fa9b929), verified functionally by eth_call mint() on all four chains. Current holders, reconstructed from full event histories and hasRole/eth_getCode reads: Polygon 12 (deployer EOA 0x08abf5f6, operator EOA 0xb35fdcb2, and 10 issuer-owned contracts/proxies), Gnosis 5 (3 EOAs + 2 backend proxies), Celo 4 (3 EOAs + 1 backend proxy), Moonbeam 5 (3 EOAs + 2 backend proxies). The two EOAs listed here previously (0x36cd3733, 0x55127198) hold the BLACKLISTED role (0xf48dee1a…), not mint rights — mint() from 0x36cd3733 reverts 'missing role 0x97667070…'. No bridge or third-party contract holds mint rights on any chain; issuance is issuer-direct per chain.

review.evidence: 2026-07-20 re-review. Functional gating: eth_call mint() succeeds from OPERATOR_ROLE holders on Polygon, Gnosis, Celo, and Moonbeam and reverts 'missing role 0x97667070c54ef182b0f5858b034beac1b6f3089aa2d3188bb1e8929f4fa9b929' from non-holders; OPERATOR_ROLE() returns that hash on all four chains (BRLAV1_1 verified source on PolygonScan). Holder enumeration: complete RoleGranted/RoleRevoked event scans on all four chains (public archive RPCs) plus hasRole verification at Polygon block 90539985, Gnosis 47292620, Celo 72615641, Moonbeam 16514336. Polygon: 12 current holders — deployer EOA 0x08abf5f6 ('BRLA Digital: Deployer'), operator EOA 0xb35fdcb2, seven Ownable mint-executor contracts owned by 0x08abf5f6 (0x061194fd, 0x18c4acf5, 0x66b2816d, 0xdff6a5f8, 0xe41d3fcb, 0xed5fc3f3, 0xf25020df), and three Avenia backend proxies (0x2305256f, 0x59704d78, 0xa5e1a817). Gnosis: 0x08abf5f6, 0x19df6878, 0xbb6878b9 (EOAs) + proxies 0xca0402fb (owner 0x08abf5f6) and 0xa5e1a817. Celo: the same three EOAs (granted in the event-less initializer at deployment block 31056500) + 0xa5e1a817. Moonbeam: the same three EOAs + proxies 0x5b6ee295 (owner 0x08abf5f6) and 0xa5e1a817. Moonbeam supply is no longer zero (~2.7k BRLA at block 16514336). Correction to the 2026-07-15 review: the two EOAs it listed as Polygon minters (0x36cd3733, 0x55127198) hold the BLACKLISTED role (0xf48dee1a72497b…, returned by BLACKLISTED()) — they can block/unblock addresses but cannot mint; nine EOAs currently hold that blocklist role on Polygon. UHY Bendoraytes performs monthly independent examinations; the latest reviewed report covers May 31, 2026 and fully reconciles BRLA liabilities to reserve assets. The Banco Central do Brasil supervised-entity registry did not match BRLA Digital/Avenia as an authorized prudential institution, and Avenia's own legal notice identifies BRLA Digital only as Ouribank's foreign-exchange correspondent. Supervision is therefore attestation-only.
